summary: EduTech Nova - a Kivy-to-web conversion of an educational app built with React and TypeScript, featuring a quiz section and motivational messages screen.
architectural_notes: Built with React and TypeScript, no external UI libraries
All screens (home, quiz, motivation, result) managed via a single 'screen' state variable
Quiz data and motivational quotes are hardcoded arrays in the component

existing_features.title: Create a Home screen with a prominent 'EduTech Nova' title/logo area, two primary action buttons — 'Start Quiz' and 'Motivation' — and smooth navigation between sections.

Build a Quiz section where the user is presented with a series of multiple-choice questions. Track the user's answers, show real-time feedback (correct/incorrect), and display a final score summary at the end.
Build a Motivation section that displays an inspirational or study-encouragement message. Include a 'Get New Motivation' button that fetches a different motivational message each time.

Apply a vibrant, academic-inspired visual theme with bold typography, bright accent colors evoking energy and learning (e.g., warm amber, teal, and off-white), card-based layouts, and consistent iconography throughout the app.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add 'koro' motivational quotes: 'Slow growth is still growth 🌸', 'Water your dreams daily 💧', 'Protect your peace 🕊️', 'Stay consistent 🎯', 'Bloom in your time 🌷'

Add the following five 'koro' motivational quotes to the backend's motivations store so they are available for random selection in the Motivation section: 'Slow growth is still growth 🌸', 'Water your dreams daily 💧', 'Protect your peace 🕊️', 'Stay consistent 🎯', 'Bloom in your time 🌷'.
Add 25 JEE-style multiple choice questions with options and correct answers to the Quiz section

Add 25 JEE (Joint Entrance Examination) style multiple-choice questions to the backend quiz questions store. Each question must include: a question text, exactly 4 answer options (A, B, C, D), and the correct answer index. Cover topics typical of JEE preparation such as Physics (mechanics, optics, electromagnetism), Chemistry (organic, inorganic, physical chemistry), and Mathematics (algebra, calculus, coordinate geometry, trigonometry). Distribute questions across all three subjects (approximately 8-9 per subject).
